# LiveSimulators — Interactive First-Principles Engineering Simulators

> LiveSimulators (https://livesimulators.com/) is an open-access engineering simulation platform executing real-time first-principles physical and mathematical models in modern web browsers at 60 FPS using Float64 numerical integrators (including 4th-Order Runge-Kutta). Built for university engineering syllabi, laboratory exploration, and industrial plant troubleshooting conforming to international consensus standards (IEC, IEEE, API, ASME, ISA, ISO).

## Key Platform Distinctions
- **60 FPS First-Principles Solvers**: Double-precision Float64 RK4 dynamic trajectory integration directly inside the browser canvas.
- **International Consensus Standards**: Sized and bounded per IEC, IEEE, API, ASME, ISA, ISO, AISC, and ACI engineering standards.
- **Real-Time Fault Injection**: Interactive exploration of real-world equipment failure modes (cavitation vs flashing, subsynchronous resonance, CT saturation, compliance voltage starvation, IGBT thermal runaway).
- **Dual-Domain Telemetry**: Time-domain dynamic waveforms accompanied by frequency-domain spectra, Bode plots, or thermodynamic P-V / T-s state planes.
- **Zero-Install & Free Access**: 100% free, zero login, zero plugins, fully functional across desktop and mobile devices.

## Platform Comparison Guide
- [LiveSimulators vs. PhET vs. Falstad vs. MATLAB Simulink](https://livesimulators.com/comparison/): Comprehensive feature, fidelity, and standards compliance matrix for engineering students and university faculty.

## Citation & Academic Attribution
To cite LiveSimulators or any individual simulator in academic literature, research papers, course syllabi, or lab manuals, use the following plain-text citation format:

Sharma, A. (2026). [Simulator Title]. LiveSimulators. Retrieved from https://livesimulators.com/simulator/[simulator-id]/

BibTeX entry format:
```bibtex
@misc{livesimulators_[simulator_id]_2026,
  author = {Sharma, A.},
  title = {[Simulator Title]},
  year = {2026},
  howpublished = {LiveSimulators},
  url = {https://livesimulators.com/simulator/[simulator-id]/}
}
```

## Engineering Departments & Curricular Taxonomy
Explore all engineering disciplines and their interactive mathematical curricula:
- [Electrical & Electronic Systems (EE-200)](https://livesimulators.com/departments/electrical/): Analog circuits, switching power topologies, RF transmission lines, 3-phase grid power, and semiconductor dynamics. Core equation: `v(t) = L(di / dt) + Ri(t) + (1 / C)∫ i(t)dt`
- [Control Systems & Robotics (CS-300)](https://livesimulators.com/departments/control/): Closed-loop feedback stability, PID gain tuning, root locus analysis, state-space representations, and inverted pendulum dynamics. Core equation: `u(t) = K_p e(t) + K_i ∫_0^t e(τ)dτ + K_d (de(t) / dt)`
- [Mechanical & Thermal Dynamics (ME-400)](https://livesimulators.com/departments/mechanical/): Damped harmonic oscillators, multi-degree-of-freedom vibrations, thermodynamic Carnot cycles, and heat transfer convection. Core equation: `mẍ + cẋ + kx = F_0 cos(ω t)`
- [Chemical & Process Engineering (CH-250)](https://livesimulators.com/departments/chemical/): Continuous Stirred Tank Reactors (CSTR), McCabe-Thiele distillation columns, TEMA shell-and-tube heat exchangers, and packed gas absorbers. Core equation: `(dC_A / dt) = (F / V)(C_A0 - C_A) - k_0 e^-E_a/RT C_A^2`
- [Civil & Structural Mechanics (CE-320)](https://livesimulators.com/departments/civil/): Truss axial stress distribution, Euler-Bernoulli beam deflection under uniform distributed loads, and seismic response spectra. Core equation: `EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x)`
- [Quantum & Semiconductor Physics (PH-500)](https://livesimulators.com/departments/physics/): P-N junction energy band bending, SiC MOSFET switching dynamics, IGBT multi-layer thermal Foster networks, and BSIM4 inversion channels. Core equation: `iħ (∂ / ∂ t) Ψ( r ,t) = [ -(ħ^2 / 2m)∇^2 + V( r ) ] Ψ( r ,t)`

## Simulators Grouped by Engineering Department

### Electrical & Electronic Systems (EE-200)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/departments/electrical/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `v(t) = L(di / dt) + Ri(t) + (1 / C)∫ i(t)dt`
- **Core Subfields**: Power Electronics, RF & Transmission Lines, Analog Active Filters, 3-Phase AC Grids, Semiconductor Physics

Simulators:
- [RLC Resonant Circuit & Damping Transient](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rlc-resonance/): Observe underdamped ringing, critical damping, and impedance resonance in real time.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rlc-resonance/
  - Governing Formulation: `ω_0 = (1 / √(LC)), ζ = (R / 2)√((C / L))`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 1459-2010 / IEC 60076 (Power Factor, Resonance & Damping Dynamics)
  - Direct Answer Summary: The series RLC circuit is governed by Kirchhoff's Voltage Law with natural resonant frequency \omega_0 = 1/\sqrt{LC} and damping ratio \zeta = (R/2)\sqrt{C/L}. Boundary stability requires R > 0 with critical resistance R_{crit} = 2\sqrt{L/C}. Standardized under IEEE Std 1459-2010 and IEC 60076 for power factor compensation and substation resonant overvoltage mitigation.
  - Physical Law: Kirchhoff's Voltage Law & Faraday Induction | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [3-Phase AC Synchronous Motor & Rotating Field](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/three-phase-ac/): Track how three balanced 120° sinusoidal currents generate a continuous rotating stator flux vector.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/three-phase-ac/
  - Governing Formulation: `vec(B)_net(t) = (3 / 2) B_m [ cos(ω t)i^ + sin(ω t)j^ ]`
  - International Standards: IEC 60034-1 / IEEE 141 / IS 3043 (Standard R-Y-B-N 4-Wire Sequence)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Balanced three-phase networks satisfy active power P = \sqrt{3} V_L I_L \cos\phi and reactive power Q = \sqrt{3} V_L I_L \sin\phi. Boundary conditions mandate 120-degree symmetrical displacement with neutral current I_N = 0. Governed by IEEE Std 1159 and IEC 61000-4-30 Class A compliance for industrial distribution efficiency.
  - Physical Law: Faraday-Lenz Law & Lorentz Force Torque | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Buck-Boost DC-DC Switching Regulator](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/buck-boost-converter/): Explore inductor energy storage, Continuous vs Discontinuous mode, and voltage inversion.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/buck-boost-converter/
  - Governing Formulation: `V_out = -V_in(D / 1 - D), Δ I_L = (V_in D / L f_sw)`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 1573 / IEC 62040 (Switching Mode Power Regulators)
  - Direct Answer Summary: The inverting buck-boost converter converts DC voltages according to V_{out} = -V_{in} D / (1 - D). Boundary continuous-conduction mode requires L > (1 - D)^2 R / (2 f_{sw}) under duty ratio 0 < D < 0.85. Designed per IEC 62477-1 and IEEE Std 1515 for automotive and renewable energy conversion.
  - Physical Law: Conservation of Energy & Volt-Second Balance | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [2nd-Order Sallen-Key Active Low-Pass Filter](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sallen-key-filter/): Tweak component values to shape Butterworth, Chebyshev, or Bessel frequency responses.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sallen-key-filter/
  - Governing Formulation: `H(s) = (K ω_c^2 / s^2 + (ω_c / Q) s + ω_c^2), f_c = (1 / 2π √(R_1 R_2 C_1 C_2))`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 1057 / Butterworth-Chebyshev Biquad Filter Realization
  - Direct Answer Summary: The 2nd-order Sallen-Key low-pass filter exhibits cut-off frequency f_c = 1 / (2\pi\sqrt{R_1 R_2 C_1 C_2}) and quality factor Q. Operational stability requires amplifier gain K < 3 for equal-component layouts to avoid Right-Half-Plane poles. Compliant with IEEE Std 1668 and IEC 60384 for precision anti-aliasing.
  - Physical Law: Negative Feedback & Complex Pole Placement | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [RF Transmission Line & Reflection Coefficient](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transmission-line/): See incident and reflected TEM voltage waves collide to form standing wave envelopes.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transmission-line/
  - Governing Formulation: `Gamma = (Z_L - Z_0 / Z_L + Z_0), VSWR = (1 + |Gamma| / 1 - |Gamma|)`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 399 / Pozar Microwave Engineering (Telegrapher Equations)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Uniform transmission lines are governed by Telegrapher's equations with characteristic impedance Z_0 = \sqrt{(R + j\omega L)/(G + j\omega C)} and voltage reflection coefficient \Gamma = (Z_L - Z_0)/(Z_L + Z_0). Matched conditions mandate Z_L = Z_0 (VSWR = 1.0). Engineered per IEEE Std 142 and MIL-STD-188-124B for RF power transfer.
  - Physical Law: Telegrapher's Equations & Boundary Wave Reflection | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Fourier Series Harmonic Decomposition & THD](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/fourier-synthesis/): Sum discrete sinusoidal harmonics to assemble square, triangle, and pulse waveforms.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/fourier-synthesis/
  - Governing Formulation: `f(t) = (4 / π) ∑_n=1,3,5,dots^N (1 / n) sin(n ω_0 t)`
  - International Standards: IEEE 519 (Recommended Practice for Harmonic Control in Electric Power)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Periodic signals decompose into Fourier series f(t) = a_0 + \sum [a_n \cos(n\omega_0 t) + b_n \sin(n\omega_0 t)] with total harmonic distortion THD = \sqrt{\sum_{n=2} V_n^2} / V_1. Standard grid operations require THD < 5.0% per IEEE Std 519-2022 and IEC 61000-3-2 to ensure power quality and equipment longevity.
  - Physical Law: Orthogonality of Sinusoidal Basis Functions | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [Operational Amplifier (Op-Amp) Linear & Filter Topologies](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/op-amp-circuits/): Explore inverting, non-inverting, integrator, and differentiator op-amp circuits with supply rail saturation clipping.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/op-amp-circuits/
  - Governing Formulation: `V_out = -(R_f / R_in) V_in (Inverting) , V_out = (1 + (R_f / R_in)) V_in (Non-Inverting)`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 107-1988 (Standard Definitions of Terms for Op-Amps) / IEC 60748-4
  - Direct Answer Summary: Linear operational amplifier circuits operate under virtual short assumptions V_+ = V_- and zero input bias current. Governing transfer functions are V_{out} = -(R_f/R_{in})V_{in} (inverting) and V_{out} = (1 + R_f/R_1)V_{in} (non-inverting). Designed per IEEE Std 314 and IEC 60748-3 for instrumentation integrity.
  - Physical Law: Ideal Op-Amp Golden Rules: Infinite Input Impedance (I_in = 0) & Virtual Short (V_+ = V_-) | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [RC & RL Circuit Transients & Exponential Time Constants](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-rl-transient/): Track charge accumulation, inductive kick, time constant τ, and 5τ settling response.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-rl-transient/
  - Governing Formulation: `v_C(t) = V_0 (1 - e^-t/RC), i_L(t) = (V_0 / R) (1 - e^-t/(L/R))`
  - International Standards: IEC 60384-1 / IEEE Std 399 (Brown Book - Transient Analysis)
  - Direct Answer Summary: First-order RC and RL transient circuits obey exponential relaxations v_C(t) = V_0(1 - e^{-t/\tau}) with \tau = RC, and i_L(t) = I_0(1 - e^{-t/\tau}) with \tau = L/R. Full steady-state equilibrium requires t \ge 5\tau (99.3%). Regulated under IEC 60947-4-1 and IEEE C37.04 for inductive switching protection.
  - Physical Law: Conservation of Electric Charge & Lenz-Faraday Magnetic Flux Invariance | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [Single-Phase Transformer OC & SC Tests (Equivalent Circuit)](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transformer-oc-sc-test/): Extract core losses (Rc, Xm) and winding impedance (Req, Xeq) to calculate full-load efficiency and regulation.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/transformer-oc-sc-test/
  - Governing Formulation: `R_c = (V_oc^2 / P_oc), X_m = (V_oc / I_m), R_eq = (P_sc / I_sc^2), X_eq = √(Z_sc^2 - R_eq^2)`
  - International Standards: IEEE C57.12.90 / IEC 60076-1 (Standard Test Code for Liquid-Immersed Distribution & Power Transformers)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Transformer equivalent circuit parameters are decoupled via Open-Circuit test (R_c = V_{oc}^2 / P_{oc}, X_m = V_{oc} / I_m) and Short-Circuit test (R_{eq} = P_{sc} / I_{sc}^2, X_{eq} = \sqrt{Z_{sc}^2 - R_{eq}^2}). Tested per IEEE Std C57.12.90 and IEC 60076-1 to verify core iron and copper loss guarantees.
  - Physical Law: Faraday Law of Induction, Ampere Biot-Savart Law & Steinmetz Core Loss | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [DC Shunt & Separately Excited Motor Speed Control](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/dc-motor-speed-control/): Master armature voltage regulation, field flux weakening, Ward-Leonard control, and speed-torque droop.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/dc-motor-speed-control/
  - Governing Formulation: `ω = (V_t - I_a R_a / k_e Φ), T_e = k_t Φ I_a, E_b = k_e Φ ω`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 113 / IEC 60034-1 (Guide on Test Procedures for Direct-Current Machines)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Separately excited DC motors satisfy speed equation \omega = (V_a - I_a R_a) / (K_e \Phi) and electromagnetic torque T_e = K_t \Phi I_a. Boundary operating states enforce armature current I_a \le 2.0 I_{rated} and minimum field excitation \Phi > \Phi_{min}. Regulated by NEMA MG-1 Part 14 and IEC 60034-1.
  - Physical Law: Lorentz Force Law & Faraday Law of Counter-Electromotive Force | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [3-Phase Induction Motor Torque-Slip & Breakdown Speed](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/induction-motor-torque-slip/): Explore stator R-X parameters, starting torque, pull-out breakdown T_max, and rotor resistance effects.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/induction-motor-torque-slip/
  - Governing Formulation: `T_e = (3 V_1,th^2 (R_2' / s) / ω_s [(R_th + R_2' / s)^2 + (X_th + X_2')^2]), s_max = (R_2' / √(R_th^2 + (X_th + X_2')^2))`
  - International Standards: IEC 60034-12 / NEMA MG-1 Part 12 (Starting Performance of Single-Speed Three-Phase Cage Induction Motors)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Three-phase induction motor electrodynamics follow the IEEE/Steinmetz torque-slip relation with breakdown slip s_{max} = R_2' / \sqrt{R_{th}^2 + (X_{th} + X_2')^2}. Operating envelopes enforce slip 0.01 \le s \le 0.05 and pull-out torque ratio T_{max}/T_{rated} \ge 2.0. Compliant with IEC 60034-12 and NEMA MG-1 Design B.
  - Physical Law: Faraday Electromagnetic Induction & Maximum Power Transfer Theorem | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Solar PV Cell Single-Diode Model & MPPT Tracking](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/solar-pv-mppt/): Simulate single-diode I-V & P-V curves, irradiance/temperature impacts, and P&O Maximum Power Point Tracking.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/solar-pv-mppt/
  - Governing Formulation: `I = I_ph - I_0 [exp((q(V + I R_s) / n N_s k_B T)) - 1] - (V + I R_s / R_sh), P_max = V_mp I_mp`
  - International Standards: IEC 60904-1 / IEC 60891 / IEEE 1547 (Photovoltaic Devices - Measurement of Current-Voltage Characteristics)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Photovoltaic current follows Shockley diode physics I = I_{ph} - I_0[\exp(q(V + I R_s)/(n k T)) - 1] - (V + I R_s)/R_{sh} with Maximum Power Point (MPP) tracking. Environmental boundaries span 100 \le G \le 1200 \text{ W/m}^2 and -20 \le T \le 85^\circ\text{C}. Governed by IEC 60904 and IEEE 1547-2018 standards.
  - Physical Law: Shockley Semiconductor Diode Equation & Photovoltaic Effect | Difficulty: Intermediate Level

### Control Systems & Robotics (CS-300)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/departments/control/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `u(t) = K_p e(t) + K_i ∫_0^t e(τ)dτ + K_d (de(t) / dt)`
- **Core Subfields**: PID Controllers, Bode & Nyquist Plots, State-Space Feedback, Inverted Pendulum, Robotic Kinematics

Simulators:
- [Industrial Closed-Loop PID Tuning & Anti-Windup](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pid-tuning/): Tune proportional, integral, and derivative gains with integrator anti-windup clamping.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pid-tuning/
  - Governing Formulation: `u(t) = K_p e(t) + (K_p / T_i) ∫_0^t e(τ)dτ + K_p T_d (de(t) / dt)`
  - International Standards: ISA S51.1 / IEC 61131-3 / NAMUR NE 43 (Industrial Process Automation & Control)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Closed-loop PID regulation computes control output u(t) = K_p e(t) + K_i \int e(\tau)d\tau + K_d (de/dt) with anti-windup clamping u_{min} \le u(t) \le u_{max}. System stability requires gain margin GM \ge 6.0 dB and phase margin PM \ge 45^\circ. Built to ISA-51.1 and IEC 61131-3 standards for industrial automation.
  - Physical Law: Nyquist Stability & Classical Negative Feedback | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Pneumatic Control Valve Flow Cv & Cavitation](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/control-valve/): Compare Linear, Equal-Percentage, and Quick-Opening trims under varying differential pressures.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/control-valve/
  - Governing Formulation: `Q = C_v N_1 F_p √((Δ P / SG)), σ_c = (P_1 - P_v / Δ P)`
  - International Standards: IEC 60534-2-1 / ISA-75.01.01 / ISA-75.02 (Industrial-Process Control Valves Sizing)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Control valve sizing follows standard flow coefficient formulation C_v = 1.156 Q \sqrt{SG / \Delta P} with equal-percentage or linear trims. Cavitation avoidance enforces cavitation index \sigma = (P_1 - P_v)/(P_1 - P_2) > 1.5. Standardized under IEC 60534-2-1 and ISA-75.01 for severe-service process throttling.
  - Physical Law: Bernoulli Fluid Continuity & Cavitation Choking | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [4-20mA Current Loop Transmitter & Line Resistance](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/current-loop/): Simulate 2-wire smart transmitters, cable loop resistance drops, and NAMUR fault alarms.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/current-loop/
  - Governing Formulation: `I_loop = 4 mA + 16 mA ((PV - LRV / URV - LRV)), V_term = V_s - I_loop(R_wire + R_load)`
  - International Standards: IEC 60381-1 / NAMUR NE 43 / ISA-50.1 (Analogue Signals for Process Control Systems)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Industrial two-wire 4–20 mA instrumentation loops map process variables via I_{loop} = 4\text{ mA} + 16\text{ mA} \times [(PV - PV_{min}) / (PV_{max} - PV_{min})]. Compliance requires terminal voltage V_{term} = V_s - I_{loop}(R_{wire} + R_{load}) \ge 11.5\text{ VDC}. Calibrated per IEC 60381-1 and NAMUR NE 43 for process telemetry.
  - Physical Law: Ohm’s Law & Kirchhoff’s Voltage Loop | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [Differential Pressure Orifice Plate Flowmeter](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/orifice-meter/): Calculate volumetric flow through concentric thin-plate square-edge orifices and tap dP.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/orifice-meter/
  - Governing Formulation: `q_m = (C_d / √(1 - β^4)) ε (π / 4) d^2 √(2 ρ Δ P), β = (d / D)`
  - International Standards: ISO 5167-2:2003 / ASME MFC-3M / AGA Report No. 3 (Measurement of Fluid Flow by Orifice Plates)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Differential pressure flow measurement across concentric orifice plates obeys Q_m = [C_d / \sqrt{1 - \beta^4}] \epsilon (\pi d^2 / 4) \sqrt{2 \rho_1 \Delta P} with diameter ratio \beta = d/D. Operational validity requires 0.20 \le \beta \le 0.75 and pipe Re_D \ge 5000. Verified per ISO 5167-2 and ASME MFC-3M standards.
  - Physical Law: Bernoulli Conservation of Fluid Energy & Continuity | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Bode Plot & Nyquist Diagram Frequency Stability](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/bode-nyquist-stability/): Evaluate Gain Margin, Phase Margin, crossover frequencies, and Cauchy stability encirclements.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/bode-nyquist-stability/
  - Governing Formulation: `G(jω) = (K ω_n^2 / -ω^2 + 2jζω_nω + ω_n^2) e^-jω T_d`
  - International Standards: IEEE Std 421.5 / IEC 60050-351 (Control Technology Terms & Frequency Response)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Frequency-domain stability evaluates open-loop transfer function G(j\omega)H(j\omega) via Cauchy's Argument Principle Z = N + P. Absolute closed-loop stability mandates Phase Margin PM \ge 45^\circ and Gain Margin GM \ge 6.0 dB. Calibrated under IEEE Control Systems Society and IEC 61508 safety standards.
  - Physical Law: Cauchy Argument Principle & Nyquist Stability Criterion (Z = N + P) | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Root Locus Plotter & Closed-Loop Stability Analysis](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/root-locus-plotter/): Trace closed-loop pole trajectories across the complex s-plane as feedback gain K varies from 0 to ∞.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/root-locus-plotter/
  - Governing Formulation: `1 + K G(s)H(s) = 0 ⟹ |K G(s)H(s)| = 1, ∠ G(s)H(s) = ± (2k + 1)180^circ`
  - International Standards: IEEE Control Systems Society Guidelines / Evans Root-Locus Method / ANSI/IEEE Std 260
  - Direct Answer Summary: Evans Root Locus tracks closed-loop pole trajectories satisfying 1 + K G(s)H(s) = 0 via angle criteria \sum \theta_z - \sum \theta_p = \pm 180^\circ(2k + 1). Closed-loop stability requires all poles in the Left-Half-Plane (LHP) with damping ratio \zeta \ge 0.5. Compliant with IEEE Std 100 control criteria.
  - Physical Law: Cauchy Argument Principle & Evans Closed-Loop Characteristic Stability | Difficulty: Advanced Level

### Mechanical & Thermal Dynamics (ME-400)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/departments/mechanical/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `mẍ + cẋ + kx = F_0 cos(ω t)`
- **Core Subfields**: Vibration & Resonance, Carnot & Rankine Cycles, Heat Exchanger Conduction, Gear Train Dynamics, Fluid Bernouilli Flow

Simulators:
- [Planar 4-Bar Grashof Kinematics & Coupler Curves](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/four-bar-mechanism/): Synthesize crank-rocker vs double-crank inversions and trace continuous coupler point trajectories.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/four-bar-mechanism/
  - Governing Formulation: `s + l ≤ p + q, K_1 cosθ_4 - K_2 cosθ_2 + K_3 = cos(θ_2 - θ_4)`
  - International Standards: ISO 13348 / ASME B105 / Freudenstein Analytical Kinematics
  - Direct Answer Summary: Planar four-bar kinematics satisfy Grashof's theorem s + l \le p + q for continuous crank rotation. Mechanism transmission angle \mu between coupler and rocker must satisfy 40^\circ \le \mu \le 140^\circ to prevent kinematic binding. Standardized under ISO 1122-1 and ASME B94.19 machine kinematic criteria.
  - Physical Law: Grashof Mechanism Inversion & Loop-Closure Constraint | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Thermodynamic Rankine Steam Power Cycle](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rankine-cycle/): Track steam expansion through high-pressure boilers, turbines, condensers, and feed pumps on a T-s diagram.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rankine-cycle/
  - Governing Formulation: `η_th = (w_net / q_in) = ((h_1 - h_2) - (h_4 - h_3) / h_1 - h_4)`
  - International Standards: ASME PTC 6 / IAPWS-IF97 (Steam Turbines & Industrial Power Plant Acceptance)
  - Direct Answer Summary: The steam Rankine power cycle converts heat to work with thermal efficiency \eta_{th} = [(h_1 - h_2) - (h_4 - h_3)] / (h_1 - h_4). Turbine exhaust expansion enforces minimum steam quality x_2 \ge 0.88 (maximum 12% moisture limit). Governed by ASME PTC 4.4 and IEC 60045-1 for steam turbine power generation.
  - Physical Law: First & Second Laws of Thermodynamics (ASME PTC 4.4) | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Damped Forced Harmonic Oscillator & Resonance Peak](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/harmonic-oscillator/): Visualize mass-spring-damper resonance, phase lag φ(ω), and displacement amplification M(ω).
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/harmonic-oscillator/
  - Governing Formulation: `mẍ + cẋ + kx = F_0 cos(ω t), M(ω) = (1 / √((1-r^2)^2 + (2ζ r)^2))`
  - International Standards: ISO 10816-1 / ISO 1940-1 / ANSI S2.41 (Mechanical Vibration Evaluation)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Forced viscous harmonic vibration satisfies m \ddot{x} + c \dot{x} + k x = F_0 \cos(\omega t) with natural frequency \omega_n = \sqrt{k/m} and magnification factor M = 1 / \sqrt{(1 - r^2)^2 + (2\zeta r)^2}. Machine vibration velocity is regulated by ISO 10816 and ISO 20816 standards to prevent structural resonance.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s 2nd Law & Hookean Elastic Restoration | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [Involute Spur Gear Mesh Dynamics & Backlash](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/spur-gear-mesh/): Track tooth contact along the line of action, verify contact ratio CR ≥ 1.4, and check sliding velocity.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/spur-gear-mesh/
  - Governing Formulation: `r_b = r cos α, CR = (√(r_a1^2 - r_b1^2) + √(r_a2^2 - r_b2^2) - Csinα / p_b)`
  - International Standards: Involute Gear Geometry & Contact Ratio (Textbook Benchmark)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Conjugate spur gearing kinematics satisfy gear ratio i = z_2 / z_1 = d_2 / d_1 with base pitch p_b = \pi m \cos\alpha. Mesh continuity enforces contact ratio CR \ge 1.40 and minimum pinion tooth count z_1 \ge 17 to prevent undercutting. Rated under AGMA 2001-D04 and ISO 6336 standards.
  - Physical Law: Fundamental Law of Conjugate Gearing | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Otto & Diesel Internal Combustion Thermodynamic Cycles](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/otto-diesel-cycle/): Analyze 4-stroke spark-ignition and compression-ignition P-V diagrams with moving piston kinematics.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/otto-diesel-cycle/
  - Governing Formulation: `η_Otto = 1 - (1 / r^γ - 1), η_Diesel = 1 - (1 / r^γ-1) [ (r_c^γ - 1 / γ(r_c - 1)) ]`
  - International Standards: ASME PTC 17 (Reciprocating Internal-Combustion Engines) / SAE J1349
  - Direct Answer Summary: Internal combustion air-standard thermal efficiencies are \eta_{Otto} = 1 - 1/r^{k-1} and \eta_{Diesel} = 1 - (r_c^k - 1) / [k r^{k-1}(r_c - 1)] with specific heat ratio k = 1.4. Compression boundaries enforce r \le 12 for Otto (knock avoidance) and 14 \le r \le 22 for Diesel. Built to SAE J1349 and ISO 1585 engine standards.
  - Physical Law: First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics & Ideal Gas Law PV = mRT | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Projectile Motion & Ballistics with Aerodynamic Drag](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/projectile-motion-drag/): Compare ideal vacuum parabolic trajectory against realistic quadratic atmospheric air drag.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/projectile-motion-drag/
  - Governing Formulation: `m (dvec(v) / dt) = mvec(g) - (1 / 2)ρ C_d A |vec(v)|vec(v)`
  - International Standards: STANAG 4355 (Modified Point Mass Trajectory Model) / ISO 1151 (Flight Dynamics)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Aerodynamic projectile ballistic trajectories integrate m (d\vec{v}/dt) = m \vec{g} - \frac{1}{2} \rho C_d A |\vec{v}| \vec{v} with altitude-dependent air density \rho(y) = \rho_0 e^{-y/H}. Aerodynamic drag coefficients span 0.15 \le C_d \le 0.45 across subsonic and supersonic regimes per NATO STANAG 4355 ballistics standards.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s Second Law of Motion & Fluid Dynamic Drag Equation | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [Centrifugal Pump & System Hydraulic Operating Point](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/centrifugal-pump-curves/): Find the duty point (Q_duty, H_duty), evaluate affinity laws, hydraulic efficiency, and NPSHr margin.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/centrifugal-pump-curves/
  - Governing Formulation: `H = H_0 - k_p Q^2, H_sys = H_stat + k_pipe Q^2, (Q_1 / Q_2) = (N_1 / N_2), (H_1 / H_2) = ((N_1 / N_2))^2`
  - International Standards: HI 14.6 (Rotodynamic Pumps for Hydraulic Performance Acceptance Tests) / ISO 9906 / ASME PTC 8.2
  - Direct Answer Summary: Centrifugal pump performance follows head-capacity curve H = a - b Q^2 with Net Positive Suction Head safety margin NPSH_a \ge NPSH_r + 0.5\text{ m}. Stable operation requires operating within minimum continuous stable flow Q \ge 0.3 Q_{BEP}. Standardized under ANSI/HI 14.6 and API 610 (12th Edition) pump standards.
  - Physical Law: Euler Turbomachinery Equation, Bernoulli Conservation & Darcy-Weisbach Pipeline Friction | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Vapor-Compression Refrigeration & Heat Pump Cycle](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/refrigeration-heat-pump/): Plot the P-h diagram, evaluate evaporator subcooling/superheat, compressor isentropic efficiency, and COP.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/refrigeration-heat-pump/
  - Governing Formulation: `COP _R = (q_in / w_net) = (h_1 - h_4 / h_2 - h_1), COP _HP = COP _R + 1, η_II = ( COP _R / COP _Carnot)`
  - International Standards: ASHRAE Standard 15 / ISO 5149 / AHRI 550/590 (Safety Standard for Refrigeration Systems & Heat Pumps)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Vapor-compression refrigeration cycles operate with cooling performance COP_{cooling} = (h_1 - h_4) / (h_2 - h_1) and heating performance COP_{heating} = (h_2 - h_3) / (h_2 - h_1). Suction superheat enforces \Delta T_{sh} \ge 5.0\text{ K} to protect compressors. Governed by ASHRAE Standard 15 and EN 378 safety standards.
  - Physical Law: First & Second Laws of Thermodynamics & Clausius-Clapeyron Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium | Difficulty: Intermediate Level

### Chemical & Process Engineering (CH-250)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/departments/chemical/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `(dC_A / dt) = (F / V)(C_A0 - C_A) - k_0 e^-E_a/RT C_A^2`
- **Core Subfields**: CSTR Chemical Kinetics, McCabe-Thiele Distillation, TEMA Shell & Tube Exchangers, Packed Gas Absorbers, Reaction Thermodynamics

Simulators:
- [Non-Isothermal CSTR & Thermal Runaway Dynamics](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/cstr-kinetics/): Simulate continuous reaction kinetics, cooling jacket heat transfer, and thermal runaway thresholds.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/cstr-kinetics/
  - Governing Formulation: `V (dC_A / dt) = F(C_A0 - C_A) - V k_0 e^-E_a/RT C_A, V ρ C_p (dT / dt) = F ρ C_p(T_0 - T) + (-Δ H) V r_A - U A (T - T_c)`
  - International Standards: AIChE / Fogler Chemical Reaction Engineering / Levenspiel CSTR Benchmarks
  - Direct Answer Summary: Continuous Stirred-Tank Reactors (CSTR) obey steady-state species conservation V = F_0 X_A / (-r_A) with Arrhenius reaction kinetics -r_A = k_0 e^{-E_a/RT} C_A^n. Stable operation mandates that heat removal slope exceeds heat generation slope (Semenov/Van Heerden criteria) per OSHA PSM and API 521 standards.
  - Physical Law: Conservation of Mass, Arrhenius Law & First Law of Thermodynamics | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Binary Distillation Column & McCabe-Thiele Stages](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/distillation-column/): Step through McCabe-Thiele theoretical equilibrium trays, adjust reflux ratio, and evaluate minimum reflux R_min.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/distillation-column/
  - Governing Formulation: `y = (α x / 1 + (α - 1)x), y = (R / R+1)x + (x_D / R+1), y = (q / q-1)x - (z_F / q-1)`
  - International Standards: AIChE / ASTM D86 / API RP 521 (Distillation Column Sizing & Relief Systems)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Binary distillation column separation follows the McCabe-Thiele operating formulation y_{n+1} = [R/(R+1)] x_n + x_D / (R+1) with minimum stages determined by Fenske equation. Operational constraints enforce reflux ratio R \ge 1.2 R_{min} and vapor flooding velocity limits per API 520 and ASTM D86 distillation criteria.
  - Physical Law: Raoult's Law & Conservation of Mass and Enthalpy (AIChE) | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger & ε-NTU Rating](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/heat-exchanger/): Evaluate countercurrent thermal gradients, logarithmic mean temperature difference (LMTD), and ε-NTU effectiveness.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/heat-exchanger/
  - Governing Formulation: `Q = U A F · LMTD , ε = (1 - exp(- NTU (1 - C_r)) / 1 - C_r exp(- NTU (1 - C_r))), NTU = (UA / C_min)`
  - International Standards: TEMA Standards (10th Edition) / ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code Section VIII / API 660
  - Direct Answer Summary: Shell-and-tube heat transfer evaluates thermal duty Q = U A F \Delta T_{LMTD} with Log Mean Temperature Difference \Delta T_{LMTD} = [(\Delta T_1 - \Delta T_2) / \ln(\Delta T_1 / \Delta T_2)]. Operational safety restricts fouling resistance R_f \le 0.0004\text{ m}^2\text{K/W}. Engineered to TEMA Class R and ASME Section VIII Div 1.
  - Physical Law: Fourier's Law of Conduction, Newton's Law of Cooling & Conservation of Energy (TEMA) | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Packed Gas Absorption Tower & Flooding Hydraulics](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/gas-absorption/): Simulate countercurrent solvent scrubbing, calculate packing height Z via HTU-NTU, and detect Sherwood flooding limits.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/gas-absorption/
  - Governing Formulation: `N_A = K_y(y - y^*), Z = HTU _OG · NTU _OG, NTU _OG = ∫_y_2^y_1 (dy / y - y^*)`
  - International Standards: AIChE Equipment Testing Procedures / EPA 40 CFR Part 63 (MACT Scrubbers) / Perry’s Chemical Engineers Handbook
  - Direct Answer Summary: Packed gas absorption towers calculate packing height via Z = H_{OG} N_{OG} with number of transfer units N_{OG} = \int [dy / (y - y^*)] and height H_{OG} = G_m / (K_y a S). Design enforces liquid-to-gas ratio (L/G) \ge 1.25 (L/G)_{min} and operates below Sherwood flooding boundaries per EPA MACT and AIChE standards.
  - Physical Law: Whitman Two-Film Theory & Sherwood-Eckert Flooding Hydrodynamics | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Batch Reactor & Plug Flow Reactor (PFR) Kinetics](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/batch-pfr-kinetics/): Compare 1st vs 2nd order kinetics, Arrhenius temperature sensitivity, Damköhler number Da, and conversion X_A.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/batch-pfr-kinetics/
  - Governing Formulation: `-(dC_A / dt) = k(T) C_A^n, k(T) = k_0 exp(-(E_a / R T)), X_A = 1 - (C_A / C_A0), Da = k C_A0^n-1 τ`
  - International Standards: AIChE Guidelines / Levenspiel Chemical Reaction Engineering / Fogler CRE Benchmarks
  - Direct Answer Summary: Plug Flow Reactors (PFR) model continuous tubular conversion via space time \tau = V / v_0 = C_{A0} \int_0^{X_A} [dX_A / (-r_A)] with Damköhler number Da = k C_{A0}^{n-1} \tau. Reaction engineering boundaries enforce isothermal tolerance \Delta T \le 5^\circ\text{C} and radial velocity uniformity per Fogler CRE and OSHA PSM guidelines.
  - Physical Law: Law of Mass Action & Arrhenius Activation Energy Kinetics | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Liquid-Liquid Extraction (LLE) & Ternary Phase Equilibrium](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/liquid-extraction/): Simulate countercurrent solvent extraction, binodal phase envelopes, and Hunter-Nash equilibrium stages.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/liquid-extraction/
  - Governing Formulation: `K_D = (y_B / x_B), N = (ln[(1 - (1 / E_f))((x_F - y_S/m / x_R - y_S/m)) + (1 / E_f)] / ln(E_f)), E_f = (m S / F)`
  - International Standards: AIChE Unit Operations / ASTM D971 / Perry's Chemical Engineers' Handbook Sec. 15 (Liquid-Liquid Extraction)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Countercurrent liquid-liquid extraction models ternary solute partitioning via distribution coefficient K_D = x_E / x_R and extraction factor E = K_D (S / F) > 1.3. Phase boundaries mandate density differential \Delta \rho \ge 50\text{ kg/m}^3 to prevent emulsion rag-layer formation per AIChE and ASTM D1159 criteria.
  - Physical Law: Nernst Distribution Law & Hunter-Nash Ternary Liquid-Liquid Phase Equilibrium | Difficulty: Intermediate Level

### Civil & Structural Mechanics (CE-320)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/departments/civil/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x)`
- **Core Subfields**: Beam Bending & Shear, Warren & Pratt Trusses, Buckling Instability, Seismic Base Isolation, Soil Consolidation

Simulators:
- [Euler-Bernoulli Beam Deflection, Shear & Moment](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/beam-bending/): Calculate Shear Force Diagrams (SFD), Bending Moments (BMD), and elastic deflection profiles.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/beam-bending/
  - Governing Formulation: `EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x), σ_max = (M_max y / I)`
  - International Standards: AISC 360-16 / Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1) / ASTM A36 (Structural Steel Design)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Elastic transverse flexure obeys Euler-Bernoulli fourth-order formulation EI (d^4 w / dx^4) = q(x) with flexural stress \sigma = M y / I and shear stress \tau = V Q / (I b). Safe design enforces \sigma \le \sigma_{yield} / 1.67 and deflection \delta \le L/360. Built per AISC 360-16 and Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1).
  - Physical Law: Euler-Bernoulli Beam Theory & Hooke’s Law | Difficulty: Fundamentals Level
- [Warren & Pratt Truss Bridge Analysis](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/truss-bridge/): Solve Method of Joints 2D nodal equilibrium under moving deck truck live loads and check Euler buckling.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/truss-bridge/
  - Governing Formulation: `∑ vec(F)_node = 0, P_cr = (π^2 E I / (K L)^2)`
  - International Standards: AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design Specifications / AISC 360-16 / Eurocode 1 (EN 1991-2)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Planar pin-jointed trusses are solved via Method of Joints and Sections satisfying static equilibrium \sum F_x = 0, \sum F_y = 0. Compression members enforce Euler buckling limit P_{cr} = \pi^2 E I / (K L)^2 with safety factor FS \ge 2.12. Certified under AASHTO LRFD Bridge Design and AREMA Chapter 15.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s Static Equilibrium & Euler Column Buckling | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Seismic Base Isolation & Dynamic Multi-Story Response](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/seismic-base-isolation/): Compare conventional fixed-base vs elastomeric Lead-Rubber Bearing (LRB) building lateral drift.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/seismic-base-isolation/
  - Governing Formulation: `M ü + C u̇ + K u = -M ü_g(t), T_n = 2π √((m / k))`
  - International Standards: ASCE 7-22 Chapter 17 / FEMA P-1051 / Eurocode 8 (EN 1998-1)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Seismic base isolation decouples structures via elastomeric Lead-Rubber Bearings (LRBs), elongating fundamental period T_b = 2\pi\sqrt{m / k_{iso}} \gg T_s and providing hysteretic damping \beta_{eff} \ge 15\%. Design limits inter-story drift to < 1.5% per ASCE 7-22 Chapter 17 and FEMA 356 seismic criteria.
  - Physical Law: Newton’s Second Law & Elastomeric Hysteresis | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [Mohr’s Circle of Stress & Soil Shear Slip Failure](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mohr-circle-soil/): Transform 2D normal and shear stresses to principal axes (σ₁, σ₂) and evaluate Coulomb failure envelopes.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mohr-circle-soil/
  - Governing Formulation: `τ_f = c + σ_n tan φ, R = √(((σ_x - σ_y / 2))^2 + τ_xy^2)`
  - International Standards: ASTM D3080 / BS 1377-7 / Eurocode 7 (EN 1997-1) (Direct Shear & Soil Triaxial Tests)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Geotechnical shear failure satisfies the Mohr-Coulomb criterion \tau_f = c' + \sigma_n' \tan\phi' with principal stresses \sigma_1', \sigma_3' = [(\sigma_x + \sigma_y)/2] \pm \sqrt{[(\sigma_x - \sigma_y)/2]^2 + \tau_{xy}^2}. Slope stability enforces factor of safety FS \ge 1.50 per ASTM D3080 and Eurocode 7 (EN 1997-1).
  - Physical Law: Stress Tensor Coordinate Transformation & Coulomb Friction | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Reinforced Concrete Beam Flexural Design & Whitney Stress Block](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-beam-design/): Calculate nominal moment capacity Mn, Whitney block depth a, rebar strain εt, and tension-controlled safety.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/rc-beam-design/
  - Governing Formulation: `M_n = A_s f_y (d - (a / 2)), a = (A_s f_y / 0.85 f'_c b), c = (a / β_1), ε_t = 0.003 (d - c / c)`
  - International Standards: ACI 318-19 (Building Code Requirements for Structural Concrete) / Eurocode 2 (EN 1992-1-1)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Reinforced concrete flexure follows Whitney stress block formulation with nominal moment M_n = A_s f_y (d - a/2) where a = A_s f_y / (0.85 f'_c b). Ductile design enforces tension-controlled strain \epsilon_t \ge 0.005 with strength reduction factor \phi = 0.90. Compliant with ACI 318-19 and Eurocode 2.
  - Physical Law: Euler-Bernoulli Plane Sections Remain Plane & Internal Moment Couple Equilibrium | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Euler Column Buckling & P-Delta Instability](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/column-buckling/): Calculate elastic critical bifurcation loads, effective length K factors, and non-linear P-Δ amplification.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/column-buckling/
  - Governing Formulation: `P_cr = (π^2 E I / (K L)^2), σ_cr = (π^2 E / λ^2), λ = (K L / r)`
  - International Standards: AISC 360-16 Section E3 / Eurocode 3 (EN 1993-1-1) / ASTM E9 (Compressive Testing & Column Instability)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Slender column stability is governed by Euler critical buckling formulation P_{cr} = \pi^2 E I / (K L)^2 with slenderness ratio \lambda = K L / r. Transition to inelastic buckling occurs when \lambda < \pi \sqrt{2 E / F_y}. Built per AISC 360-16 Specification Chapter E and ASME Section VIII structural standards.
  - Physical Law: Euler's Buckling Theory & Geometric Non-Linearity (P-Δ Effect) | Difficulty: Intermediate Level

### Quantum & Semiconductor Physics (PH-500)
- **Department Hub**: https://livesimulators.com/departments/physics/
- **Governing Discipline Equation**: `iħ (∂ / ∂ t) Ψ( r ,t) = [ -(ħ^2 / 2m)∇^2 + V( r ) ] Ψ( r ,t)`
- **Core Subfields**: P-N Diode Band Diagram, SiC MOSFET Double-Pulse, IGBT Thermal Foster Model, MOSFET Inversion Channel, Quantum Well Tunneling

Simulators:
- [P-N Junction Diode Band Bending & Carrier Transport](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pn-junction/): Visualize energy band bending (Ec, Ev, Ef), space-charge depletion width, and carrier drift-diffusion.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/pn-junction/
  - Governing Formulation: `W = √((2ε_s / q)((1 / N_A) + (1 / N_D))(V_bi - V_a)), I = I_s(e^qV_a / k_B T - 1)`
  - International Standards: IEEE Trans. Electron Devices / Sze Physics of Semiconductor Devices
  - Direct Answer Summary: Semiconductor P-N diode physics obey the Shockley formulation J = J_0 [\exp(q V_a / k T) - 1] with built-in potential V_{bi} = (k T / q) \ln(N_A N_D / n_i^2) and depletion width W = \sqrt{(2\epsilon_s / q)(1/N_A + 1/N_D)(V_{bi} - V_a)}. Operating temperature is limited to T \le 150^\circ\text{C} per JEDEC JESD22 and IEC 60747-2 standards.
  - Physical Law: Poisson's Electrostatic Equation & Fermi-Dirac Carrier Distribution | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFET Double-Pulse Switching & Slew Rates](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sic-switching/): Capture ultra-fast dv/dt (up to 100 V/ns), Miller plateau dynamics, inductive ringing, and switching energy losses E_on / E_off.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/sic-switching/
  - Governing Formulation: `E_sw = ∫_0^t_sw v_ds(t) · i_d(t) dt, ((dv / dt))_max = (V_gs - V_plat / R_g,tot C_gd(V_ds))`
  - International Standards: JEDEC JESD24-11 / IEC 60747-8 / IEC 60747-9 (Power Semiconductor Switching Tests)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFET switching dynamics follow energy loss formulations E_{sw} = \int V_{ds}(t) I_d(t) dt with fast gate slew rates dV/dt \le 100\text{ V/ns}. Gate oxide voltages are constrained to -4\text{ V} \le V_{gs} \le +18\text{ V}. Governed by JEDEC JEP183 and IEC 60747-8 wide-bandgap guidelines.
  - Physical Law: Maxwell's Displacement Current, Carrier Drift-Diffusion & Parasitic RLC Resonant Tank | Difficulty: Advanced Level
- [IGBT Module Multi-Layer Thermal Foster Network & SOA](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/igbt-thermal/): Model multi-layer conduction from Silicon Die through DBC ceramic and baseplate to heatsink, tracking T_j ripple.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/igbt-thermal/
  - Governing Formulation: `Z_th(t) = ∑_i=1^4 R_i (1 - e^-t / τ_i), T_j(t) = T_a + P_tot R_th(j-a) + Δ T_j,ripple`
  - International Standards: IEC 60747-15 / JEDEC JESD51-14 / SEMI G42 (Thermal Test of Power Semiconductor Devices)
  - Direct Answer Summary: IGBT module transient thermal impedance follows the multi-layer Foster/Cauer RC network T_j(t) = T_c + P_{loss} \sum R_i (1 - e^{-t/\tau_i}) with junction temperature constrained to T_j \le 175^\circ\text{C}. Short-circuit withstand is rated for t_{sc} \le 10\ \mu\text{s} per IEC 60747-9 and JEDEC JESD51 power electronics standards.
  - Physical Law: Fourier Heat Conduction & Electro-Thermal Network Analogy (JEDEC JESD51) | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [MOSFET Inversion Channel, Band Bending & 2D Electron Gas](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mosfet-channel/): Solve surface potential band bending, visualize 2D electron sheet accumulation, and observe channel pinch-off.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/mosfet-channel/
  - Governing Formulation: `φ_s = (q N_A W_dep^2 / 2ε_s), Q_inv = -C_ox(V_gs - V_th), I_D = μ C_ox (W / L)[(V_gs - V_th)V_ds - (V_ds^2 / 2)]`
  - International Standards: IEEE Trans. Electron Devices / BSIM4 Standard MOSFET Model / Sze Physics of Semiconductor Devices
  - Direct Answer Summary: MOSFET field-effect conduction follows BSIM channel physics with linear current I_D = \mu_n C_{ox} (W/L)[(V_{GS} - V_{th})V_{DS} - V_{DS}^2/2] and saturation I_D = \frac{1}{2} \mu_n C_{ox} (W/L)(V_{GS} - V_{th})^2(1 + \lambda V_{DS}). Gate dielectric electric field is bounded by E_{ox} \le 10\text{ MV/cm} per JEDEC JESD77 and IEC 60747-8 standards.
  - Physical Law: Poisson-Boltzmann Electrostatics & Fermi-Dirac Statistics (BSIM4) | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Photoelectric Effect & Einstein Quantum Work Function](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/photoelectric-effect/): Verify quantum photon particle theory, metal work functions Φ, and stopping potential V_stop.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/photoelectric-effect/
  - Governing Formulation: `K_max = hν - Φ = q V_stop`
  - International Standards: NIST Reference on Constants, Units, and Uncertainty (CODATA Planck Constant h)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Photoelectric quantum emission satisfies Einstein's conservation formulation E_{k,max} = h\nu - \Phi = q V_{stop} where \Phi is the cathode work function and \nu_0 = \Phi/h is threshold frequency. Photocurrent scales linearly with incident photon flux. Calibrated to NIST fundamental physical constants and IEC 60027 standards.
  - Physical Law: Planck-Einstein Quantum Relation E = hν & Energy Conservation | Difficulty: Intermediate Level
- [Quantum Barrier Tunneling & Resonant Diode (RTD) NDR](https://livesimulators.com/simulator/quantum-tunneling/): Simulate WKB barrier tunneling, resonant double-barrier transmission, and negative differential resistance.
  - Direct URL: https://livesimulators.com/simulator/quantum-tunneling/
  - Governing Formulation: `T(E) ≈ exp(-2 ∫_x_1^x_2 √((2m^* / ħ^2)big(V(x) - Ebig)) dx), I(V) = (2e / h)∫ T(E,V)big(f_L(E) - f_R(E)big) dE`
  - International Standards: IEEE Electron Devices Society (EDS) / NIST Quantum Devices Benchmark / ISO/IEC 80000-10 (Quantum & Solid-State Physics)
  - Direct Answer Summary: Quantum mechanical barrier tunneling follows the WKB transmission formulation T(E) \approx 16 (E/V_0)(1 - E/V_0) e^{-2\kappa a} with decay parameter \kappa = \sqrt{2m(V_0 - E)}/\hbar. Applicable across barrier thicknesses a \le 5.0\text{ nm}. Governed by IEEE Nanotechnology Council and ISO 80000-10 quantum physical standards.
  - Physical Law: Time-Independent Schrödinger Equation & WKB Wavepacket Tunneling | Difficulty: Advanced Level

## Mechanical Engineering Digital Twins (Subdomain)
Full-fidelity mechanical turbomachinery simulators at https://mech.livesimulators.com. Calculations reference standard methodologies published in API (610/617/618), ISO (1940), ASME (B31.3), and AGMA (2001) literature for educational and preliminary design purposes.

## Cornerstone Engineering Educational Guides
- [RLC Resonance Explained](https://livesimulators.com/guides/rlc-resonance-explained.html): Complete engineering guide covering 2nd-order RLC frequency response, damping ratio, quality factor, and transient impedance.
- [Rankine Cycle T-s Diagram](https://livesimulators.com/guides/rankine-cycle-ts-diagram.html): Complete thermodynamic guide to steam power cycles, superheat expansion, pump work, and condenser backpressure on T-s diagrams.
- [PID Tuning Step-by-Step](https://livesimulators.com/guides/pid-tuning-step-by-step.html): Complete guide to tuning industrial proportional, integral, and derivative loops with anti-windup clamping.
- [Beam Deflection Euler-Bernoulli](https://livesimulators.com/guides/beam-deflection-euler-bernoulli.html): Complete structural guide to Euler-Bernoulli 4th-order beam deflection, shear force, bending moments, and AISC L/360 limits.
- [Four-Bar Mechanism Kinematics](https://livesimulators.com/guides/four-bar-mechanism-kinematics.html): Complete kinematic guide to planar 4-bar link inversions, Grashof mobility, transmission angle limits, and coupler curves.
